issue_request: FHIR-34314 was a Published FHIR-core change request resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked that xhtml not remain an undefined special-purpose datatype and required PrimitiveType links on datatypes.html to point to types.html, plus an explicit narrative.html xhtml section explaining no intrinsic length limit, profile-constrainable length, no extensions, and id rendering as xml:id in XML.
initial_application: Git commit de45347b3f5c7bb159ea4b78ba1efce9cc982485 explicitly applied FHIR-34314 by adding an XHTML Content section to source/narrative.html and adjusting datatype presentation text. Current source also has the type-page mapping that routes xhtml references to narrative.html and datatypes.html now links PrimitiveType to types.html#PrimitiveType.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2021-11-29 record the FHIR-34314 discussion and 17-0-0 Persuasive with Modification vote, including the existing xhtml XML/JSON definition links and id/extension inheritance questions. A 2022 Zulip thread clarified that the PrimitiveType part of the request concerned a wrong datatypes-page UML diagram/link target. No conflicting later Jira, Zulip, Confluence, or source-history evidence was found in the bounded reconciliation checks.
